info.about: VioraPlay is a directory of browser games. Games are provided through third-party Playgama embeds; VioraPlay supplies navigation, search, recommendations and browser-local favorites.
info.contact: For broken game links or website issues, use our GitHub issue tracker. Do not include passwords, payment details or other private information in public reports.
info.privacy: Favorites and recently visited games are saved in this browser using local storage, without a VioraPlay account. Clearing site data removes these records. The site uses Google Analytics to measure visits and site interactions. Embedded games connect to Playgama and may load advertising or use storage under the provider’s privacy policies. VioraPlay cannot read the contents of cross-origin game frames.
info.terms: Games run through third-party providers and may show ads. Availability, game rules and in-game services depend on the provider. Respect the rights of game creators and use the site lawfully. Reloading a game may reset progress that the provider has not saved.
